meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 HTML 和时间轴搭出可渲染的视频合成项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要用代码定义片段与轨道来生成或渲染视频动画。
copy.tagline_en: Build a renderable video composition with clips, tracks, and exact timing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you define clips and tracks in code to render video animations

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 HyperFrames 合成契约写 HTML:用 data-* 属性在 DOM 里声明时间,注册一个暂停的 GSAP 时间轴,媒体播放交给框架,并跑 lint/check 校验后再渲染成视频。
howto.when: 当你要写或改 HyperFrames 合成 HTML(结构、data-* 时间属性、轨道与子合成等),或要跑校验时接管。

say.text: 用 HyperFrames 写一个最小可渲染的合成骨架
say.note: 给出 index.html 骨架并提示跑 lint

say.text: 给这个合成加一段从 2 秒开始的视频片段
跑 hyperframes check,看这个合成有没有问题
say.note: 报告 lint、布局与对比度结果

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude builds HyperFrames composition HTML: the DOM declares timing with data-* attributes, one paused GSAP timeline is registered, media playback is framework-owned, and it runs lint/check before rendering to video.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you build or edit a HyperFrames composition — structure, data-* timing attributes, clips, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, media playback, or validation — before writing composition HTML.

say_en.text: Write a minimal renderable HyperFrames composition skeleton
say_en.note: Gives an index.html skeleton plus a lint run

say_en.text: Add a video clip starting at 2s to this composition
Run hyperframes check on this composition
say_en.note: Reports lint, layout and contrast results
